question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I have _________ my mind after meeting her.
solution:
The correct answer is: **changed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Changed"** means to make or become different; to alter or modify something. (बदल दिया)

 
 
• **Example:** She changed her outfit before the party.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that since meeting her, the person's opinion has altered.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **"Changed"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Masked **(नकाबपोश): Concealed or hidden behind a mask or disguise.

 
 
• **Example:** His true feelings were masked by his calm demeanor.
 
 
 
• **Granted **(स्वीकृत): Given or allowed formally.
 
 
• **Example:** She was granted permission to leave early.
 
 
 
• **Replaced** (प्रतिस्थापित): To take the place of something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The old computer was replaced with a new one.
